purpose: Translate external literature into fail-closed implementation requirements for RLL background inference, perturbation closure, CLASS/CAMB parity and structure-growth validation without importing another model's physics as RLL physics.
source_boundary: External papers are literature evidence and implementation guidance. They do not resolve TOKEN_VAZIO_RLL_PERTURBATION_CLOSURE_RELATIONS and do not authorize model-selection claims.

papers.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints
extracted_findings: Primary DESI DR2 authority for compressed BAO observables and cosmological constraints.
RLL data custody/order/covariance checks must trace to the primary DESI products rather than only to secondary model papers.
rll_action: Bind DESI DR2 likelihood/data receipts to this primary authority.
Require vector-order, covariance and hash provenance before background comparison.
Do not treat data materialization as evidence for RLL.

papers.title: The Pantheon+ Analysis: Cosmological Constraints
extracted_findings: Primary Pantheon+ cosmology reference for 1701 light curves of 1550 Type Ia supernovae and systematic treatment.
Pantheon+ likelihood use requires the dataset/covariance provenance boundary to remain explicit.
rll_action: Bind Pantheon+ catalog and STAT+SYS covariance receipts to this primary authority.
Preserve nuisance/calibration treatment and z-cut provenance in every formal fit.
Do not promote a covariance-ready run to a scientific claim without the remaining gates.

papers.title: No preference for generalized emergent dark energy from current cosmological data
extracted_findings: Uses DESI DR2 BAO with CMB and Type Ia supernovae including Pantheon+.
GEDE parameter Delta is consistent with the LambdaCDM value Delta=0 within 2 sigma once SNe Ia are included.
Gaussian significance below 2 sigma and Bayesian evidence lnB<1 do not establish preference for GEDE over LambdaCDM.
Inference uses CAMB/Cobaya and full CMB information rather than background-only BAO/SN optimization.
rll_action: Preserve G4 background-only results as limited evidence.
Do not promote a background-fit improvement or equality to physical preference.
Require G6 posterior/evidence and perturbation/CMB gates before any model-selection claim.

papers.title: Reassessing Evidence for Dark-Sector Interactions with Dynamical Dark Energy and DESI DR2
extracted_findings: Studies Q=beta H rho_de with perturbations evolved using a generalized PPF treatment.
The statistical role and even sign of a preferred interaction depend strongly on the assumed dark-energy trajectory.
Interacting GEDE can strongly suppress matter power while improving a CMB+BAO+SNIa fit.
RSD, galaxy clustering, weak lensing and cluster abundance are identified as direct tests of the growth predictions.
rll_action: Treat interaction-like background degeneracy as non-identifying.
Require perturbation-derived P(k), f_sigma8 and lensing/RSD confrontation before interaction claims.
Keep route B interacting-sector semantics independent from route A1 and background-only route C.

papers.title: IDECAMB: an implementation of interacting dark energy cosmology in CAMB
extracted_findings: A covariant interaction requires background Q plus perturbative deltaQ and momentum-transfer f components.
Energy-density, velocity, pressure perturbation and anisotropic stress variables must close the perturbation system.
Gauge transformation of pressure perturbations and rest-frame sound-speed semantics must be explicit.
Large-scale instability can require a PPF-type treatment for coupled-fluid models.
rll_action: If RLL route B is selected, Q_mu must decompose into Q, deltaQ and momentum-transfer terms with one declared frame/gauge convention.
A hidden background Q is insufficient for solver implementation.
Large-scale/super-horizon stability is a mandatory gate, not an optimizer prior workaround.

papers.title: Consistent Initial Conditions for Early Modified Gravity in Effective Field Theory
extracted_findings: Beyond-standard perturbation systems can require model-consistent initial conditions rather than reused GR initial conditions.
Inconsistent initial conditions can generate measurable changes in CMB spectra.
Super-horizon evolution and conserved metric-potential behavior provide diagnostic constraints.
rll_action: C07 cannot be closed by copying standard GR initial values.
Derive a super-horizon series/constraint-compatible mode from the frozen RLL equations.
Test the initial solution against conservation/constraint residuals before Boltzmann handoff.

papers.title: The Cosmic Linear Anisotropy Solving System (CLASS) III: Comparision with CAMB for LambdaCDM
extracted_findings: Independent CLASS and CAMB calculations reached about 0.01 percent agreement for reference LambdaCDM lensed CMB and matter spectra when physical assumptions and precision settings were aligned.
Parity requires matched physical inputs such as recombination history and explicit numerical convergence tests.
The paper compares CMB TT/EE/lensing and matter P(k), not only background H(z).
rll_action: CLASS and CAMB RLL integrations must be independent implementations of one frozen solver-neutral equation contract.
Baseline LambdaCDM recovery and numerical-convergence sweeps must precede RLL cross-backend comparison.
The historical 0.01 percent LambdaCDM result is a reference, not an automatically inherited RLL acceptance threshold; RLL tolerance must be preregistered after convergence studies.

parity_reference.historical_lcdm_reference: ~0.01 percent in arXiv:1104.2934 for aligned high-precision CLASS/CAMB reference spectra
parity_reference.rule: Do not copy the historical LambdaCDM threshold into RLL. Freeze tolerance only after independent convergence sweeps demonstrate the numerical floor for the implemented RLL closure.

citation_policy: Every external literature action must resolve to a citation_key present in a canonical BibTeX file.
DATA_AUTHORITY references bind dataset/likelihood provenance; they do not support RLL preference.
IMPLEMENTATION_REFERENCE equations are constraints/guides, not imported RLL equations.
COMPARATOR and FALSIFIER_GUIDE references define comparison/falsification surfaces, not truth scores.
